name: Tony Dungy's Tampa 2
description: The defining middle-of-field-closed Cover 2 of its era: a penetrating four-man rush behind corners who squat in the deep halves with underneath-first eyes, and safeties splitting the field. The signature wrinkle is the Mike linebacker converting his hook-curl drop into a full sprint to the deep-middle hole, erasing the seams that normally kill Cover 2. Quick perimeter answers are contested instantly, forcing quarterbacks to hold for seam throws that sail straight into the sprinting Mike.
